summary: Iter-29 sprint validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 test_iteration29_sprint.py PASS; combined regression 47/47 PASS across iter25-29. Frontend: (1) Auto-enrol RSVP roundtrip verified end-to-end — creating a course+session as admin, unauth'd learner, RSVP UI click fires two toasts: 'You're RSVP'd' + '✨ You've also been enrolled in the courseOpen'. API response has {status:'RSVP', auto_enrolled:true, course_id}. Second RSVP (idempotency) correctly returns auto_enrolled:false. Session with no course_id returns auto_enrolled:false. (2) ConfirmDialog fully exercised via Cert revoke flow — opens with correct data-testids (confirm-dialog, confirm-dialog-title, confirm-dialog-description, confirm-dialog-confirm, confirm-dialog-cancel), title reads 'Revoke this certificate?', Cancel closes dialog with no side-effect, Confirm proceeds → cert-revoked-banner-{id} appears + red border + reduced opacity + cert-unrevoke-{id} button materialises; clicking Unrevoke restores state (unrevoke has NO confirm dialog, direct action — intentional per code). AttendanceModal 'Mark all as ATTENDED' bulk button works: on session where all learners are already ATTENDED, correctly short-circuits with 'Everyone is already marked ATTENDED' sonner toast + no request (verified in browser). (3) PUBLIC_BASE_URL override confirmed via /api/seo/sitemap.xml and /api/seo/robots.txt — all URLs use https://code-quality-check-31.preview.emergentagent.com instead of cluster-internal host. (4) Certificate revocation full lifecycle: POST /revoke sets revoked flag, /verify returns valid:false + revoked_at + revoked_reason, learner PDF returns 410 Gone, admin PDF still 200, share HTML contains 'REVOKED' + '[REVOKED]' title prefix, og-image.svg contains REVOKED overlay text, /unrevoke fully restores; non-admin 403 on revoke; GET /certificates includes revoked_at/revoked_reason on each row.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `import { api } from 'lib/api'` caused 4 TS2304 compile errors that blackscreened the entire React app with a 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Any user visiting the app while this file was in the bundle saw the compile error page instead of the app. Fixed by adding the missing import.

action_items: None blocking — ImportsPage.tsx missing-import fix already applied by testing agent. Main agent should double-check the fix and consider adding an ESLint rule (no-undef on TS) to catch this class of missing-import at commit time, since the app compiled the change but broke at runtime with the CRA hot-reload compile-problems overlay.

Cosmetic (non-blocking): Unrevoke action on CertificatesPage does NOT prompt a confirm dialog (unlike Revoke). This appears intentional (unrevoke is non-destructive) but worth confirming the UX choice with the product owner. If a confirm is desired, wrap the api.post call in a `useConfirm({...})` block similar to revokeCert.
critical_code_review_comments: IMPORTS PAGE COMPILE BUG (frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ImportsPage.tsx) — File was migrated to useConfirm() in iter-29 but the `api` module import was accidentally dropped. Because the file is bundled in the main app chunk (via router lazy import chain), any browser visiting the app rendered CRA's 'Compiled with problems' overlay instead of the actual UI. This is a CRITICAL production-impact bug that would have blocked ALL frontend features. RCA: likely an editor auto-format/organize-imports run that removed a seemingly-unused import while the new useConfirm import was being added. Fix applied by testing agent: added `import { api } from 'lib/api'` after the useConfirm import. Recommend adding a pre-commit lint step or CI check that runs `tsc --noEmit` so this never ships again.

COHORT AUTO-ENROL (routers/live_sessions.py::toggle_rsvp) — Logic looks clean: guards on `session.course_id is not None` and existing Enrollment row before inserting; returns explicit {auto_enrolled: bool, course_id: int|None} in the payload so the frontend can decide whether to fire the celebratory toast + Open action. Verified idempotent (second RSVP → auto_enrolled=false) and cross-conditions (no course → false; already enrolled → false). Series-wide RSVP path (?series=true) uses the series head's course_id — worth adding one more regression test that exercises the series head course specifically, but the code path shares the same helper so functionally covered.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL OVERRIDE (routers/seo.py::_base) — Correctly checks env var first, falls back to Host header for local dev. Sitemap loc entries + robots.txt Sitemap: directive both use the override. This resolves the iter-28 observation about cluster-internal hostname leaking into crawler-facing artifacts.

CONFIRMDIALOG COMPONENT (components/ConfirmDialog.tsx) — Radix Portal-based dialog with a Promise-returning useConfirm() hook is a clean pattern. All required data-testids present (confirm-dialog, confirm-dialog-title, confirm-dialog-description, confirm-dialog-confirm, confirm-dialog-cancel). Cancel path returns false with no side-effect; Confirm returns true. 12+ pages migrated successfully — verified CertificatesPage.tsx, AttendanceModal.tsx, ImportsPage.tsx (post-fix) all use the hook correctly.

CERTIFICATE REVOCATION (routers/misc.py::revoke_certificate + unrevoke_certificate) — Sets revoked_at (UTC timestamp) + revoked_reason on the Certificate row, gated by admin role check (403 for LEARNER). Verify endpoint composes {valid: revoked_at is None, revoked_at, revoked_reason} correctly. PDF download returns 410 Gone for revoked + non-admin caller; admin still gets 200 for audit purposes — good separation of concerns. Share HTML injects '[REVOKED]' prefix into <title> + og:title so LinkedIn cache invalidates cleanly on re-scrape. OG SVG overlays a red 'REVOKED' band. All response fields (revoked_at, revoked_reason) exposed via CertificateOut schema so frontend can render banner state.

ATTENDANCEMODAL BULK-MARK MIGRATION (AttendanceModal.tsx::markAllAttended) — Now uses `useConfirm({title, description, confirmLabel:'Mark all', variant:'default'})` instead of window.confirm(). Short-circuit path (all attendees already ATTENDED) fires sonner info toast and skips the dialog — verified in-browser. When there ARE unmarked learners, the confirm dialog opens as expected (verified structurally via the identical component behaviour on CertificatesPage revoke).

Notes: (1) Learner learner@ifpi.org now has ~43 certificates (was 28 at iter-28); tests should always use the LAST cert or create fresh ones to avoid disturbing regression baselines. rca of the issue: ImportsPage.tsx TS2304 'Cannot find name api' — Root cause: file was edited for iter-29 (added useConfirm import, migrated window.confirm to useConfirm) but the pre-existing `import { api } from 'lib/api'` line was accidentally removed at the same time (likely by an editor's organize-imports on an incorrectly-parsed file at the moment useConfirm was added). Because the file compiles as TypeScript but fails at type-check, CRA's dev server shows the 'Compiled with problems' overlay to the user and blocks the app render. Reproduction: visit any page while this file is bundled → whole app is a black overlay. Fix: added `import { api } from 'lib/api'` after the useConfirm import (single-line addition). Mitigation for the future: add `tsc --noEmit` to the pre-push hook or CI so type errors block merges.
